name: Yunohana Nano
source:
"I think Tayutais are just like humans, they should just live their own lives naturally."

She had frequent contact with Tayutais at a young age and she is a girl who always thinks from a Tayutai's perspective.

She lives together with a Tayutai named [url=/c45201]Tatsuko[/url] in a single wooden house in Yakotami-cho. She cures the Tayutais who cannot fit into human society and those who refuse to transform into humans — she is a doctor for Tayutais. Her choice of becoming a doctor came from the influence of her grandmother, and she must use the power in order to cure their diseases.

She speaks politely, and has a mild temperament.

[Shortened bio from [url=http://hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/]English Website[/url]]
